easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Fiend Hunter, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Yannik until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
